# crosswork_alarm_severities (Resource)

This resource can manage the severity and the auto clear time of the alarm and event types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_alarm_severities" "example" {
  severities = [
    {
      name               = "L2-ELMI-4-AIPC"
      severity           = "minor"
      auto_clear_minutes = 1440
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `severities` (Attributes List) The alarm and event types to manage, by the name of the Severity and auto clear page. A type that is not listed keeps its values, and so does a value that a row leaves out (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--severities))

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--severities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `severities`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the alarm or event type, as the Name column of the Severity and auto clear page shows it. It is case-sensitive

Optional:

- `auto_clear_minutes` (Number) Minutes after which Crosswork clears the alarm. Up to 55 a multiple of 5, from 60 a multiple of 60. Crosswork cannot return to the built-in value, so write the value you want
  - Range: `5`-`599940`
- `severity` (String) Severity of the type. Crosswork ignores a severity for the few types that the page does not list, and the apply refuses it
  - Choices: `critical`, `major`, `minor`, `warning`, `information`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_alarm_severities.example "alarm_severities"
```
